stage.label: 02 Build Blueprint
stage.summary: ProjectManager reads the blueprint, splits it into 5 sub blueprints, and dispatches them to Foreman-A through Foreman-E.

children.label: PM reads blueprint
children.summary: Read and summarize the validated blueprint.

children.label: PM splits blueprint
children.summary: Split the full blueprint into 5 Foreman sub blueprints.

children.label: PM dispatches sub blueprints
children.summary: Send one sub blueprint to each Foreman.

events.action: Read the validated blueprint before assigning Foremen.
sublines: tool_call: Read Blueprint[xini.json] -> success, 95,151 blocks, 52 active levels, bounds x[-60,30] z[6,148]
log: scan output collapsed -> detailed level checks kept internal for demo clarity

events.action: Summarize the material profile for Foreman planning.
sublines: log: top materials -> quartz_block 71,662; birch_planks 6,899; oak_planks 6,542; smooth_quartz 5,342
log: support materials -> stripped_jungle_log 1,551; gray_concrete 1,646; gray_wool 619

events.action: Split the full blueprint into 5 Foreman sub blueprints.
sublines: tool_call: Split Blueprint[xini.json, groups: 5, method: x/z region partition] -> success, 5 sub blueprints prepared
progress: blueprint split 0% -> 100%

events.action: Package Region-A as a sub blueprint for Foreman-A.
sublines: tool_call: Create Sub Blueprint[Region-A, Workers 001-020] -> success, 42 subtasks estimated
log: region packet -> Region-A, Worker range 001-020

events.action: Dispatch Region-A to Foreman-A.
sublines: tool_call: Dispatch Sub Blueprint[Foreman-A, Region-A, Workers 001-020] -> success

events.action: Region-A received; Worker group ready.
sublines: send_msg: [ProjectManager, Region-A received by Foreman-A] -> success
